_comment: Louisiana 2025 QAP, Louisiana Housing Corporation ('Final as of 02-14-25'). Page numbers are PDF page indices, matching the printed numbers. Scoring is Appendix A (pp.39-41), a self-score sheet with values in a right-hand column. The text layer keeps them in reading order, but a few values (Elderly, 6) are cut off, so all three pages were read from rendered images and checked against the text. NO TOTAL IS STATED; the minimum is 40 points (p.17). Hand-summed before loading: I 11 (Community Redevelopment 3 + rehabilitation or new construction 8), II 6, III 13 (5 + 4 + 4, matching its stated 13), IV 5, V 16 (2 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 2 + 3; section V states no cap) = 51. The loader matched. Appendix A section VI (items H-K) lists threshold acknowledgements with no points, coded in LA_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: No total stated. Computed 51. Minimum score 40 (p.17), so a qualifying application may miss only 11 points.
